about_the_game:
Demo Description

This demo offers a glimpse into the beginning of Myosotis. You’ll experience the first day and night of Frank Miller’s story—an introduction to his quiet, lonely life and the people who still remain in it.

Step into Frank’s home, explore his daily routine, and meet the key characters who shape his world. As night falls, the tone shifts, and you’ll begin to uncover the unease that lingers in the shadows of his house.

The demo showcases the core gameplay of Myosotis: first-person exploration, environmental storytelling, and narrative-driven moments that reveal the emotional and psychological depth of Frank’s world.

Myosotis is a narrative-driven, linear experience that follows the story of Frank Miller, an elderly man living alone after the loss of his wife, Judie.

What begins as an ordinary life quickly unravels into something far stranger. Days slip by with small, almost unnoticeable changes… and nights bring shadows that refuse to stay buried.

The Story

Frank Miller once lived a simple, quiet life with his wife Judie. After her passing, he spends his days going through familiar routines, visited now and then by his only daughter, Ellie, and her unfamiliar husband, Nick.

But something is wrong.
The house doesn’t feel the same.
The nights grow heavier, haunted by echoes of Judie that creep through the halls. Conversations change. Rooms feel unfamiliar.

As the story unfolds, you begin to question what’s real, what’s memory… and what’s slipping away.

Gameplay

Myosotis focuses on immersive, atmospheric storytelling. The experience is driven by exploration, dialogue, and interactive moments that bring Frank’s life to the forefront.

  • First-person perspective: See the world through Frank’s eyes as it gradually changes around you.

  • Interactive environments: Small details tell the story—photographs, letters.

  • Narrative progression: Conversations and events guide you through an intimate, personal journey.

The game is designed to be experienced at a deliberate pace, pulling you deeper into Frank’s world one day—and one night—at a time.

Key Features

  • A deeply emotional, story-rich experience.

  • An atmospheric world that shifts in subtle, unsettling ways.

  • A linear narrative focused on love, loss, and the human condition.

  • Minimal HUD, no distractions—just you and the story.
